result.summary: Wrote two independent, non-production GDScript test files implementing every functional witness required by EQUIPMENT-LIFETIME-R01v1 against the actual candidate `inventory.gd` public API (as shown in the supplied source, verbatim method/refusal names — no invented API). `godot/test/test_equipment_authority_lifetime.gd` is a discovered `test_case.gd` suite covering: bind-time rejection of an authority missing the attestation method; a failed rebind preserving the previous live binding; `clear()` preserving the wiring; never-bound vs explicit-unbind both reporting `NO_EQUIPMENT_AUTHORITY`; an expired RefCounted authority (dropped, no other owner) refusing all four equipped gates (detach preflight, detach, attach preflight, attach) with the exact `INVALID_EQUIPMENT_AUTHORITY` code and byte-identical `state_bytes()` before/after each refusal; the same four-gate proof for a Node authority released via explicit `.free()` (shared assertion helper, Node freed exactly once); `audit()` refusing `AUDIT_ORPHAN_LOT` after authority expiry with no automatic unequip/normalization; explicit unbind still refusing `EQUIPPED_LOTS_LIVE` even once the bound authority has itself expired, while proving the wrapper is retained (not silently cleared to the unbound state); a live replacement authority restoring attestation and normal shelving after a prior authority expired; the existing re-entrancy guard (`ATTESTATION_REENTRY`) still holding; and a RefCounted authority that drops the caller's only external owner from inside its own attestation callback, proving `inventory.gd`'s per-call strong local keeps it alive for that one call and nothing survives after — the transient array/authority cycle used to demonstrate this is deliberately broken by the callback itself before the call returns, so no permanent test-created cycle remains (verified via `WeakRef`). `godot/test/equipment_authority_lifetime_focus.gd` is a standalone `SceneTree` script (not `test_`-prefixed, so not auto-discovered by `run_tests.gd`, matching the contract's named artifact and the existing probe's own convention) that replicates the shutdown-leak-diagnostic probe's exact real Gear/Inventory/Residents API for mutual release without unbinding, and adds a second scenario proving Gear alone — not Inventory — retains Residents/Inventory when their own external owners are dropped first, releasing all three only once Gear's own last external owner is dropped. Every file-creation/bind fixture asserts its own `.ok` before using the resulting ref/handle. No production file was modified; no decision record was created since this packet only adds test evidence under an already-accepted contract.
